title: Szechuan Knafeh Pilaf
description: A spicy twist on traditional Chinese pilaf, incorporating the popular Middle Eastern dessert knafeh.

ingredients.name: Sichuan hot pot oil
ingredients.notes: substitute with chili oil if needed

instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large pan over medium-high heat.
Add onion and garlic, stir-frying until translucent.
Add Szechuan peppercorns and Sichuan hot pot oil, stir-frying for 1 minute.
Add knafeh cheese, breaking it up with a spoon as it melts.
Add jasmine rice, stir-frying for 2 minutes.
Add soy sauce, pilaf spice blend, and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Transfer to a serving dish and garnish with extra Szechuan peppercorns if desired.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped scallions if desired.
